test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an isosceles triangle, the vertex angle measures 124°. What is the measure of each of the base angles?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an **isosceles triangle**, base angles are equal.

Sum of base angles = 180° − **Vertex angle**

Sum = 180° − 124° = 56°

Each base angle = 56° ÷ 2 = 28°

**∴ The correct answer is 28° and 28°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Vertex angle** (top angle) = 124°

Triangle type = **Isosceles Triangle**

**Formula Used:**

Sum of all internal angles of a triangle = 180°

In an **isosceles triangle**, angles opposite to equal sides are equal (Base angles).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d77a218bbbbe5327f92a336a9b2f66c653339f26052b1675f7e93d3a434bce8b.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let each **base angle** be x.

⇒ 124° + x + x = 180°

⇒ 124° + 2x = 180°

⇒ 2x = 180° − 124°

⇒ 2x = 56°

⇒ x = 56° ÷ 2

⇒ x = 28°

**∴ The correct answer is 28° and 28°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Isosceles Triangle Properties

A triangle with at least two equal sides. The angles opposite to these sides are always equal.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of the interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Equilateral Triangle

A special case of an isosceles triangle where all three sides and all three angles (each 60°) are equal.</p
